item: R123: the Keyword log and Last keyword files again buttons go from the Diagnostics panel, with the test of what the digest carries
key_paths: src/static/index.html; src/static/app-diagnostics.js; src/static/locales/*.json; src/bulletin/render.py; configs/bulletin_i18n/*.json; tests/test_keyword_log_buttons_removal.py; tests/test_bulletin_render.py; docs/USER_MANUAL.md; docs/ledger/RULINGS_INDEX.md
summary: The two buttons are out of the panel (All keywords stays as a text link; routes, file names and the page routine's modes stay). tests/test_keyword_log_buttons_removal.py states what the Diagnostics archive's keyword digest carries against the removed button's export: every summary equal (on a corpus that fits the window and on one whose languages exceed it), a labelled top 100 by mentions instead of 5,000 per language, the families summary partial and saying so on a low-memory computer (R130 = 36a), and the first files of All keywords holding the entries the log held; the texts say the digest is there when the build ran it, since a Quick build or the memory gate can leave it out. Lost, and accepted by the coordinator session: after a page reload there is no screen path to save the last numbered set again. Also: the bulletin says an unreadable baseline or a re-index backlog record that is no measurement could not be read (new sentence in the 11 catalogs), and the gzip wire-bytes test helper has a wait_for backstop. R130 row in RULINGS_INDEX; Chromium walk offline at three widths, three themes, en/ar/ja.
